_comments.usage: External skills installed by target install scripts (scripts/lib/external-skills.sh) into the target's skills directory, e.g. $CODEX_DIR/skills/<name>/. Each entry is shallow-cloned and <path> (which must contain SKILL.md) is copied.
_comments.targets: Optional per-entry array of target names (e.g. ["codex"]). An entry without it installs for every target that supports external skills; with it, only for the listed targets.
_comments.claude: The Claude Code side of these tools is tracked separately in targets/claude/plugins.json (humanize-korean@im-not-ai, humanizer@humanizer, added in PR #34; simple-english@simple-english).
_comments.humanizer: blader/humanizer documents no official Codex install; its root SKILL.md is self-contained, so the repo root is installed as the skill directory.
_comments.simple-english: AminBlg/SimpleEnglish is always on, on every target. Claude Code: the plugin in targets/claude/plugins.json (SessionStart hook + output style). Codex: the upstream Codex plugin, installed by targets/codex/install.sh from content/targets/codex/plugins.json (skill + SessionStart hook), so this entry is limited to pi and OpenCode. pi: the skill directory from this entry plus content/targets/pi/extensions/simple-english/ (injects SKILL.md on before_agent_start). OpenCode: the skill directory plus content/targets/opencode/plugins/simple-english.js (experimental.chat.system.transform hook).
_comments.trust: Entries are unpinned: each install clones the default-branch HEAD, so upstream pushes land in ~/.codex/skills/ on the next -f install. This mirrors the Claude plugin auto-update behavior and is a deliberate trust decision — only list repos you trust; pin by switching repo to a fork if needed.
